metadata.title: Global Ocean Currents and Temperature
metadata.what_you_will_try: Can you hear the year turn? Listen for the moment the whole ocean sounds warmest.

timeline.accessibility_text: Mar 25, 2007: warm surface water averaging 22.6 degrees Celsius (from 2.9 to 31.1), with steady currents and some swirling eddies. You hear bright tones and steady pulses.
timeline.echo_callout: Global Ocean Currents and Temperature. Each streak is a surface current, coloured from blue at 0 to red at 32 degrees. Listen as the year unfolds.
